[EN] The argons left huge structures all over the {@Rgn:45005$$Skyfields}. However, {@Creature:45#4003#argonomorph tuwangi warfroggers} are preventing our...less intrepid researchers from investigating them.

Will you help us clear the area?
[ES] Los argons dejaron enormes estructuras por todo {@Rgn:45005$$Skyfields}. Sin embargo, los {@Creature:45#4003#argonomorph tuwangi warfroggers} están evitando que nuestros... menos intrépidos investigadores las investiguen.

¿Nos ayudarás a despejar la zona?

[EN] Thank you. I can't wait until we can find out what all those structures are doing there.
[ES] Gracias. Ya quiero ver qué están haciendo todas esas estructuras allí.
